text: child-page activities that need many short-lived visual elements use small DOM nodes with CSS keyframes and timer-based removal (ogrod.js) or a single canvas (akwarium.js); the global prefers-reduced-motion rule in style.css disables all animations, so removal must not depend on transitionend.

child-page: the agent sandbox denies edits to .github/workflows/*; when a feature needs a pages.yml change (e.g. copying new top-level files into _site/), flag the exact change in a PR comment for a human instead of retrying.

child-page: .github/workflows/pages.yml copies an explicit file list with `cp -r` into _site; if the workflow listing new paths (manifest.webmanifest, sw.js, icons) lands on main before the PR that adds them, the deploy job fails, so merge the feature PR first or together.

child-page: playtime limit lives in js/playtime.js (window.Playtime: start/stop/isExpired/renderLater) with state in localStorage key 'swa.playtime'; app.js only calls these, and dimming is set from JS (stage opacity) so it survives the global prefers-reduced-motion rule.
child-page: Night Sky's .n-msg (Brawo + Dalej) is an absolutely positioned overlay, so the sky square can use nearly the whole short side; keep new message UI outside the sky's square.
child-page: day/night stars and constellation lines live in .dn-stars; use '.stage .dn-stars svg' selectors so the global '.stage svg' 120px rule doesn't shrink overlays.

child-page: gh-as-agent commit/pr must run from inside the clone dir (git -C from the workspace root fails: 'not a git repository'); the Playtime fade-to-moon lives in js/playtime.js renderLater(container, fromActivity) using JS rAF opacity with smoothstep so it survives prefers-reduced-motion.

child-page menu (.tiles in css/style.css) is flex-wrap with a --cols variable (1 portrait phone, 2 default, 3 at >=700px) and centred rows; app.js saves/restores menu scroll (menuScroll) because hiding #menu-view resets window scroll.

child-page: menu enabled/order config lives in js/menu-config.js (window.MenuConfig, localStorage key 'swa.menu', fires a 'menuconfig' document event); app.js builds tiles from MenuConfig.enabledActivities() and treats disabled hashes as the menu; the Settings UI is wired from playtime.js showSettings.
Developer: check `git branch` before committing; when the checked-out branch belongs to another open PR, create the new feature branch first (git checkout -b) so you don't commit onto it.

child-page Mały Pociąg (js/pociag.js, id 'pociag'): train position is a loop fraction f (0 = off left, 1 = off right) so speed/station survive resize; start/stop use 2s smoothstep speed ramps and the station stop is a cubic Hermite from current speed to 0, all in one rAF loop.

Developer: the sandbox has no browser or jsdom; sanity-check animation/physics logic by running the activity file in node against a hand-made DOM stub (fake requestAnimationFrame, document, window.ACTIVITIES).

Developer: for pooled-DOM activities (child-page banki.js) bound the total node count including fading bubbles, not just the alive ones, otherwise rapid tapping lets fading nodes pile up (91 nodes in a stub test before the fix).

Developer: child-page drag-and-drop activity (js/ksztalty.js, id 'ksztalty') uses per-shape pointer capture, clamps the dragged centre to the viewport, re-lays out on resize/orientationchange (cancelling drags into a glide home), and accumulates rAF dt for the 4s auto-reset so it pauses when the tab is hidden.

Developer: child-page Farma (js/farma.js, id 'farma') is a 4:3 board of square %-positioned buttons each holding an inline SVG; reactions are JS rAF transforms (style.transformOrigin in SVG user px) with a per-animal timer ignoring taps while active; one capped-dt loop that is cancelled when hidden.

child-page Dobranoc (js/dobranoc.js, id 'dobranoc'): 4:3 board of %-positioned native buttons (4 windows, 3 animals); each item has value v and target t eased in one capped-dt rAF loop that stops when idle; the glow target is 1 only when all lights are off and all animals asleep, so every change is reversible and works under prefers-reduced-motion.
Developer: new-activity PRs for child-page are based on the open menu branch (feature/menu-scroll-28), not main, until #35 merges; branch from origin/<that base> and pass --base to gh-as-agent pr.

Developer: when an issue lists activities in an order, the authoritative default menu order is the list in child-page js/activities.js on main (Pociąg, Bańki, Dobranoc, Deszczyk, Kształty, Farma after the first six); main moves fast, so re-read origin/main files before editing the README.

child-page deszczyk.js: the 'all clouds rain' look came from drops being spawned at a puddle's x (under other clouds); drops now fall under their own cloud and only ripple if they land within a puddle's x-range.

child-page ksztalty.js lays out two 3x3 grids (outlines and shapes) from the field rect: stacked when portrait (fh>=fw), side by side when landscape; shape size = 0.82*min(cell w,h), min 48px; SHAPE_ORDER must have no fixed point.

child-page Ścieżka (js/sciezka.js, id 'sciezka'): Catmull-Rom control points sampled into a polyline with arc-length progress; portrait uses the same shape rotated on a 3:4 board; figure chases the nearest path point ahead of it at length/7 per second, in one capped-dt rAF loop.

child-page Przeciwieństwa (js/przeciwienstwa.js, id 'przeciwienstwa'): 2x2 grid of native buttons each with an inline SVG painted by paint(svg, e); under reduced motion two static SVGs (state A/B) are cross-faded instead of animating geometry; one capped-dt rAF loop, touches ignored while an item is changing.

Developer: child-page koraliki.js (id 'koraliki') threads 8 beads onto a string: string polyline from slot points, drop accepted if bead centre is within 0.9*S of the polyline, beads on string re-glide to slots after any add/remove; one-row string or two-row curve when narrow, bowl 1x8 or 4x2 by width/height.

Developer: child-page Ubierz Misia (js/ubierz-misia.js, id 'ubierz-misia'): 400x300-unit board scaled by k=width/400 (items stored in units so resize needs no conversion), weather = per-layer weights eased in one rAF loop (works under reduced motion), worn items follow the bear's hop/tilt via a pose transform; after a drag a skipClick flag (cleared on next pointerdown and by a 60 ms timeout) stops the trailing click from taking the item off.

Developer: child-page wzorki.js (id 'wzorki', CSS prefix wz-): px layout computed in JS from the field size (single-row 7-bead string, two rows when narrow so beads stay >=56px); one SVG for string/beads, 2 HTML choice buttons, one capped-dt rAF loop with phases play/glide/glow/wait/out/in; patterns rotate bead types per round and the correct side never repeats 3 times.

Developer: child-page duze-i-male.js (id 'duze-i-male', CSS prefix dm-): px layout from field size (big animal B=clamp(min(0.28w,0.2h),96,180), small=B/2, houses sized to the space above the animal row), 2 houses + 4 animals as fixed buttons, rounds cycle 4 animal types in pairs, glow ~2s then new round at ~4s via a fade out/in phase in one capped-dt rAF loop.

child-page: for a vehicle that must loop over rows with U-turns and never reverse, build a closed path from pieces (straight rows + half-ellipse turns with an arc-length table) and keep position as a loop fraction so resize/orientation changes don't snap; planting is triggered by s-crossing checks per slot, not by x comparisons.

child-page vehicle activities with several stops: a wide bus must stay fully on screen when stopped, so use bus centre = clamp(stopX, bw/2, W-bw/2) as its stopped position and keep the stop signs on a sidewalk above the bus roof so they stay touchable.
child-page: CSS prefix rk- is taken by Rysuj Kształty (also sa-, tk-, ab-, pk-); Rakieta uses rq-. Grep css/style.css for a prefix before choosing one.

child-page vehicle activities that hover and fly: keep travel heading+speed separate from the displayed sprite angle (blend upright<->heading by speed), and model 'visit a target' as a damped spring on velocity, handing velocity back to heading/speed on exit so there are no jumps.

child-page: shared randomisation helper is js/random.js exposing window.Rand (shuffle, pick, pickOne(list, key)); loaded before menu-config.js in index.html and in-memory only, so activities should use it instead of ad-hoc Math.random shuffles.

child-page: running `cd child-page && git ...` in one compound Bash call triggers an approval prompt; use `git -C <clone>` instead. A last activities.js list entry has no trailing comma, so add one when appending a new activity or node --check fails.

child-page: the global CSS class `.night` belongs to Dobranoc; new activities needing a night state must use a prefixed class (e.g. tod-night), and a day-variant rule placed later can override a night rule at equal specificity unless a combined selector follows.

child-page canvas activities (e.g. akwarium.js): to unit-test a pure helper in node without a DOM, eval the file's IIFE with the mount function cut off and expose the helper on a stub window; Rand.pick over a shape x colour product gives unique combinations.

child-page Dzień i Noc (js/dzien-i-noc.js): daytime birds are a flock (7-9) placed in lanes above/below the central .dn-body sun/moon button so they never overlap it; plane pulse is a --pulse CSS var set from the rAF loop; Nocne Niebo (niebo.js) has no plane or satellite.

child-page Nocne Niebo (js/niebo.js): shapes live in a SHAPES array of {name, ring, extra, pts} with coordinates in 0..100; to validate a new shape pool, eval the SHAPES literal in node and check bounds (8-92) and minimum node spacing (existing shapes go down to 10-12 units).

child-page: shared animal family is js/animals.js (window.Animals: LIST, head(id,{noEyes,bare,body,eyesClass,shadow}), eyes(id), pick(n,{distinct})), loaded after random.js; activities that show animals should use it rather than drawing their own.

child-page: with no browser or renderer in the sandbox, validate generated SVG strings by dumping them from node and parsing with python xml.dom.minidom, and check pick/uniqueness logic in node by requiring the plain IIFE files with a stub global.window.

child-page Policz Razem (js/policz-razem.js): scene counts come from ROWS + layout(n) (grid rows, size shrinks with n, rows centred in top 80% of the 4:3 board); object kind is picked per round with Rand.pickOne(KINDS,'policz-razem'); the counting row has 10 dots.

child-page Kolorowe Kształty (js/ksztalty.js): layouts are rebuilt per round by newRound() (g×g unique shapes and colours via Rand.pick, grid size g switches 2→3 after 3 completed rounds); the old fixed 9-element DOM no longer exists.
child-page: the local clone may be left on another feature branch; start new work with `git checkout -B <branch> origin/main` after `git fetch`.

child-page Wzorki (js/wzorki.js): PATTERNS is a list of symbol arrays over 4 bead TYPES; set order comes from nextSet() using Rand.shuffle over pattern indices, reshuffled each full cycle and swapped so a set never repeats across the cycle boundary.
child-page Kolorowe Kubeczki (js/kubeczki.js): COMBOS is a list of 3-cup colour+pattern sets (patterns plain/dots/stripes distinct); mount picks one with Rand.pickOne(COMBOS,'kubeczki') per launch.

child-page Puzzle (js/puzzle.js): pictures live in js/puzzle-pictures.js (window.PuzzlePictures, 25 SVG inner strings on 200x200, subject centred); grid sizes come from GRIDS (2x2,2x3,3x3,3x4,4x4, +1 step per 5 completed), pieces rebuilt per round by build(), layout() searches the largest piece size >=56 where frame+tray fit; a non-square grid restarts the round on orientation flip.

child-page Wieża z Klocków (js/wieza.js): makeBlocks() runs per mount, picking 5-9 shapes from SHAPES and unique colours from PALETTE via Rand.pick; waiting-area rows = ceil(n/3), BLOCKS is local to mount.

child-page Pamięć (js/pamiec.js): deal() rebuilds the card buttons per game from POOL (14 pictures) with Rand.pick; pairs = min(10, 3 + round); layout() searches the column count giving the largest square card (floor 56px).

child-page Mały Samolot (js/samolot.js): per-mount Rand.pickOne over PLANES (6 colour sets), AIRPORTS (3, each with runway/ground/hill colours and building SVG), WEATHERS (sunny/cloudy/rain/snow, CSS-only drop/flake layer under the plane) and PILOTS (6 animals drawn locally).

child-page Gdzie jest Piłka? (js/pilka.js): LAYOUTS (6: box cx, side of the 'next' spot, start spot, colours) are picked per mount with Rand.pickOne(LAYOUTS,'pilka'); spotsFor(L) and sceneFor(L) build the spots and scene SVG per layout.

child-page: the global `.stage svg { width:120px; height:120px }` rule (specificity 0,1,1) overrides single-class SVG selectors, shrinking drawings into the top-left corner (Nocne Niebo, Koraliki, Rysuj Kształty); prefix new SVG selectors with `.stage` (e.g. `.stage .kr-deco`).

child-page Łódź Podwodna (js/podwodna.js, CSS prefix pd-): sub position is a loop fraction f; sand touch glides it via a Hermite curve from its current speed to the touched x, touching it lifts it; fish circle the sub by blending the base path into a circle, clamped on screen; bubble pool of 10.
gh-as-agent commit -a only stages tracked files: `git add -A` first or new files are left out of the commit.

child-page vehicle activities (e.g. Balon, js/balon.js, prefix bn-): model height as a fraction a with slew-limited velocity (max accel, eased last ~12% each way) for jerk-free motion; in short landscape (640x360) keep the top margin small (~24px) so a 216px balloon's centre still reaches the top third.

child-page Karuzela (js/karuzela.js, prefix kz-): in-place rotation is an angle th on an elliptical orbit in a 400x300 board with ramp/coast/drag modes; drag chases the finger capped at full speed and release keeps forward momentum only, so direction never reverses.

child-page Zjeżdżalnia (js/zjezdzalnia.js, prefix zj-): feet-anchored animal sprites on a 440x300 unit board; slide is a quadratic Bezier P0(96,96) P1(235,175) P2(335,252); queue spots are recomputed every frame (head walks to ladder foot, then climbs), so orientation change just redraws.

child-page Huśtawka (js/hustawka.js, prefix hs-): swing angle = amp*sin(phase) with amp eased toward a target amplitude that each push raises (+8 deg, cap 35) and that drains linearly, so pushes never jerk; swing, seat button and animal button are siblings inside one rotating wrapper div; 6 pooled leaf elements spawn above 20 deg.

child-page Latawiec (js/latawiec.js, prefix lw-): kite is a damped spring (K=6, D=4.4) toward the finger or a figure-eight hover target with speed cap 110 board units/s; tail bows sample a position-history buffer at i*0.22 s lag; whole scene is one SVG updated per frame, kite centre clamped in 400x300 board units.

child-page Myjnia (js/myjnia.js): animals are chosen by local pickAnimal() — dog ('piesek') weight 3, others 1, previous animal excluded so the dog never repeats; the no-repeat exclusion lowers the dog's effective share to ~2.1x each other animal.

child-page Zegar z Kukułką (js/kukulka.js, prefix kk-): per-door timeline state (open 1s, out 0.6s, wave 1.8s, in 0.6s, close 1s) advanced in one rAF loop; minute hand is slew-limited (acc 45, max 30 deg/s) so queued +90 turns never reverse; characters are clipped to the door's bottom edge so they slide up out of the opening.

child-page Kąpiel Zwierzątek (js/kapiel.js, prefix kp-): one mask canvas (256x336 logical) is repainted per stage (mud, foam, damp+droplets) from an Animals.head(shadow) SVG data-URL Image; a 'wait' phase must be set BEFORE calling drawLayer because the image callback can run synchronously when cached.

child-page usage metrics: js/analytics.js (window.Analytics) is the single module that writes analytics storage (localStorage swa.stats, daily aggregates, 90-day retention); activities only call Analytics.levelStart/levelComplete/complete/track('interaction',{variant}) and app.js reports activity start/end; parent UI is js/stats-ui.js in the gated Settings. Test it in node vm with a stub clock and localStorage seeded with aggregates.

child-page: SVGs sized only by width/height attributes shrink to 120px at the top-left because `.stage svg {120px}` beats presentation attributes; set size inline or via a `.stage .cls` rule (Koraliki deco was this bug).

child-page docs: per-activity documentation lives in docs/activities/ (ACTIVITY_TEMPLATE.md with 21 sections, README.md index plus shared platform behaviour and analytics status); filenames are kebab-case without Polish characters (ł->l), e.g. zegar-z-kukulka.md. Update the activity doc when an activity changes.

child-page: a 'shared data file' foundation issue that also lists menu tile/Settings/README criteria needs a small gallery activity to host them; dog drawings live in js/dogs.js (window.Dogs, SVG part classes dg-*, size-class scales small<medium<large) with the gallery in js/rasy.js (prefix rp-).

child-page: a mud/foam mask over a Dogs breed is built by loading Dogs.draw(id) (with width/height injected) as an SVG data-URL Image, drawing it on the mask canvas and filling with source-in; cached images call back synchronously, so keep a 'wait' phase and a token guard for the async case.

child-page: a new activity also needs its row in docs/activities/README.md, the 'all N activities' count and the list of activities that call Analytics in that file's analytics-status paragraph updated, plus the README intro count word.

child-page: a 'never decided' race is built by blending each runner's speed toward a common finishing time (mean remaining time) once the leader passes ~50%, with slew-limited speed; a node stub-DOM sim showed finish gaps under 0.15 s. Dog race activity is js/wyscig.js (prefix wp-, id wyscig).

child-page: fetch/run-and-return timing is controlled by planning the speed from the round-trip length and padding very short throws with a longer pick-up pause (pause = 3.6 - 2*run time); Aport is js/aport.js (prefix ap-, id aport), the 50th activity, so README count word, docs index row and analytics-status paragraph all bump again.

child-page: a dog 'yawn' is done by tilting the .dg-head group (pivot ≈ ears data-px+4, data-py+9) and showing .dg-happy; no extra mouth overlay is needed. Nakarm Pieska is js/nakarm.js (prefix nk-, id nakarm), the 51st activity, so README count word, docs index row, 'all N' and 'Only N activities call Analytics' bump again.

child-page: Koparka (js/koparka.js, prefix kg-, id koparka) is the 52nd activity; arm = two-link IK (elbow up) with the wrist recomputed from the elbow so joints stay connected, target clamped by a box+annulus loop; scoop travel is counted only while the finger/key is active so the return-to-rest glide never scoops; README word/item, docs index row, 'all N' and 'Only N activities call Analytics' bump again.

child-page: Zbuduj Rakiete (js/zbuduj.js, prefix zr-, id zbuduj) is the 53rd activity; build+launch reuses one rocket SVG element for assembly and flight, part pictures use their slot rectangle as viewBox, and slot hit-rects come from the current pose so resize/rotation keep state; README word/item, docs index row, 'all N' and 'Only N activities call Analytics' bump again.

child-page: Plac Budowy (js/plac.js, prefix pb-, id plac) is the 54th activity; four machine buttons each hold their own SVG whose pose is a pure function of progress, blended from the previous pose on restart; README word/item, docs index row, 'all N' and 'Only N activities call Analytics' bump again.

child-page: Zakupy (js/zakupy.js, prefix zk-, id zakupy) is the 55th activity; basket+counter+scanner flow where basket items scan first and missing list products are topped up to the list length; README word/item 55, docs index row, 'all N' and 'Only thirteen activities call Analytics' bump again.

child-page: Lot na Smoku (js/smok.js, prefix sm-, id smok) is the 56th activity; canvas scenery layers loop seamlessly because each layer's offset is f*lam*m with pattern period lam/m (whole periods per loop); 'at least N lanterns visible' at 320px needs spacing ~W/8 on three height levels; README word/item, docs index row, 'all N' and 'Only fourteen' bump again.

child-page: dog mouths/tongue in js/dogs.js are built by mouths(mx, ny, sn, ry) relative to the muzzle ellipse (centre hx+hr*0.7, ny; radii snout x hr*0.5); keep new face parts inside that ellipse and verify by sampling points in node (no renderer in sandbox).

child-page Rasy Piesków (js/rasy.js, prefix rp-) shows one dog at a time with a pure pose(kind,t) table; it regroups the shared Dogs.draw SVG parts into <g> wrappers at mount (front legs, near paw, rear leg, head+ears) so dogs.js stays untouched; stub-DOM node sim needs querySelector, firstElementChild and nextElementSibling.

child-page: Dogs.mouthPoint(id, deg) in js/dogs.js returns the per-breed held-item spot (viewBox coords after size scale, head tilted about the neck pivot px,py); activities rotate .dg-head with that pivot and draw a held ball behind the dog (dogBtn z-index above ball) so the muzzle covers part of it.

child-page Nakarm Pieska (js/nakarm.js): items are six fixed DOM slots whose kind is swapped per round via setKind (icon + aria-label); KINDS entries carry ok and to ('mouth' or 'bowl'), dealKinds() draws 4 ok + 2 bad and avoids repeating the previous set; grid is 1x6 if W>=468 else 3x2.

child-page Zakupy (js/zakupy.js): shelves are 6 slots with stock 2-4 and one floating ghost per slot; counter shows max 5 items per wave (phase 'wave' loads the next batch from a queue) so a 15-item basket reuses the old geometry; basket pile overflow is reserved via pileUp in layout().

child-page Zbuduj Rakietę (js/zbuduj.js): the rocket SVG part groups (.zr-p-<slot>) start empty and place() must write PARTS[kind][idx] into them (resetRound clears them); an empty group makes placed parts and the flying rocket invisible.

child-page: to rewrite the README Activities list, generate it by script from the docs/activities/README.md index (id -> kebab-case file) plus a hand-written id->description table; docs index order equals js/activities.js order, and an old-README vs doc number/word comparison finds README-only facts.

child-page: the main README 'Usage statistics' table and docs/activities/README.md analytics table are both append-at-end lists, so planned activities need a placeholder row in each or parallel filling PRs conflict.

child-page: fill a planned-activity placeholder by editing only its own lines (stub doc, README list line, docs index row, both analytics rows); layout done purely in CSS (portrait/landscape media rule) keeps activity state across rotation without resize JS.
